stock.description: This company focuses on the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of crucial equipment for the hydrogen energy sector. Its diverse range of offerings includes advanced high-pressure hydrogen supply systems designed for vehicles, complete hydrogen refueling stations, and water electrolysis machinery for hydrogen generation. Furthermore, it delivers integrated solutions for liquid hydrogen facilities and a variety of storage vessels. Pin Fang Wu established the organization on June 13, 2016, and its headquarters are situated in Suzhou, China.
